expressions.cue: A repair will take several days, with no exact duration given. Write the compact quantity using 数 and 日 only.
expressions.explanation: 数日 is conventionally すうじつ. It names an unspecified duration, not a particular date on a calendar.

expressions.cue: A computer operation takes several minutes. Write the compact quantity using 数 and 分 only.
expressions.explanation: Here 分 counts minutes and is read ふん. Do not use the fraction reading ぶん or infer a precise duration.
